## Objectives

- Defeat 60 Drake of the Dustfall Caves ([Drakeling](../monsters/drakeling.md), [Cave Drake](../monsters/cave_drake.md), [Frost Drake](../monsters/frost_drake.md))

- 6,500 EXP
- 400 mesos

The first time you complete it instead: 6,500 EXP, 800 mesos, [Orange Potion](../items/orange_potion.md) x10, +15 standing with Midbarium, +30 standing with [Ketta](../npcs/ketta_uskari.md)
